svg.title: iOS · Projects · sync panel (Project Syncing) · PicPlace can't be reached · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/ProjectSharingChip.swift (ProjectSyncSheet.statusLine → unreachableLine, changesWaiting; sendBlock) over App/PicPlace/PicPlaceAutoSync.swift (isUnreachable, unreachableUntil, heldPushes, noteServerUnreachable / noteServerReachable) and App/PicPlace/PicPlaceAPI.swift (PicPlaceClient.reachability) — the Project Syncing sheet of projects.sharing.portrait.svg in ONE state: PicPlace gives no answer at all. **2026-09-29, code first, signed off by Steven the same day from the Mac bench; this mirror drawn after.** A request that gets no HTTP answer (no route, a timeout, a certificate that is not PicPlace's — the network of 2026-09-29 answered picplace.co with sad.certificate.that.cannot.be.valid.com) closes a gate: for 1 minute, then 2, 4, 8, 16, at most 30 after each failed look. While it is closed nothing automatic asks PicPlace anything — no check on the timer or on coming to the front, no pushes, no poster catch-ups, no blends or originals walk, no upload retries, no usage or listing reads — and an edit made meanwhile waits in heldPushes: an id in a set, no timer, no request. One look goes when the backoff runs out, or at once when the network changes; the first answer opens the gate and releases everything held (the check after it would find it all anyway). A person's press still goes: **Check PicPlace now** is live, and its answer, if one comes, opens the gate. THE SHEET'S ONE STATUS LINE (statusLine) takes a new place in its order — decisions waiting (Review) > what auto-sync is doing (spinner) > the first connection > a pause (the sending block says it) > **this line** > the last auto-sync problem > "Auto-sync waiting for Wi-Fi" (now with " · N changes waiting" when held) > "Edits go to PicPlace as you make them" — drawn here: icloud.slash (secondary) and "Can't reach picplace.co · 12 changes waiting · next try 11:40" (13.5 regular, secondary, wraps; the host is the session's, the count is heldPushes.count — "1 change waiting" singular, left out at 0 — and the time is unreachableUntil, short style). "next try 11:40" is held together with non-breaking spaces: at the phone's 337pt the line breaks after "waiting ·" (CoreText, SF 13.5: 289.0 + 84.5pt), exactly where the Mac's 360pt panel breaks it (291.5 + 86.6pt of 300, the signed-off screenshot); without them "11:40" was left alone on the second line. The icon aligns with the first line. NOT here while PicPlace is silent: the sending block — it shows only once a push of its run has begun (a project queued that turns out to need nothing never flashes it; the Mac's Size sort flashed it twice a second on 2026-09-28), and a run PicPlace went silent under ends, its unsent projects counted by this line instead; nor the check summary's "N to send". The summary says what the last check did — here it failed: "Checked 2 minutes ago · PicPlace couldn't be reached". The account line keeps the last usage it read (1553 projects; no usage read goes while silent). No downloads card (projects.sharing.portrait.svg draws one): a download is a press, not this state. With the downloads card gone and the status line two lines tall, everything from Check PicPlace now down stands 82pt higher than in projects.sharing.portrait.svg (−98 + 16). Verified: the Mac bench 2026-09-29 (Debug, a scratch root on picplace.test, LL_PICPLACE_OUTAGE=10:40, LL_PICPLACE_RENAME=…@20, LL_SYNC_PANEL=1) — "Can't reach picplace.test · 2 changes waiting · next try 15:59" with no sending block, and after the answer the held edit went and the sending block showed for the real push; the phone's wrap from CoreText, not a device (the sheet is the same SwiftUI view).
